standard.title: Use calendars
standard.description: identify the date and determine the number of days between events using calendars
standard.prior_knowledge: Students sequence and describe duration of events and order them using time language (AC9M1M03). They have not yet used a calendar to identify specific dates or calculate the number of days between events.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students identify specific dates on a calendar and determine the number of days between events by reading and using calendar structure.

nodes.label: Reading a calendar
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can locate a specific date on a calendar and identify what day of the week it falls on.
nodes.minimum_width: Locate a given date on a monthly calendar; state the day of the week it falls on.
nodes.typical_width: Locate specific dates on a calendar including school events, birthdays, public holidays; identify the day of the week for each; create a class calendar with significant dates entered.
wider: Locate and identify culturally significant dates: ANZAC Day, Easter, Diwali, Ramadan, school holidays; discuss why dates for some events change each year
Create a class calendar; enter student birthdays and upcoming school events; use it to answer questions about upcoming dates
success_criteria: Locates a named date on a monthly calendar
Identifies the day of the week for a given date

nodes.label: Days between events
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can determine the number of days between two events using a calendar, including events in the same month and across months.
nodes.minimum_width: Count the days between two events in the same month using a calendar.
nodes.typical_width: Determine the number of days between events within and across months; use addition to total days across months; locate a date 2 weeks prior to or after a given date.
wider: Model 'How many days are left in this year?' by identifying days remaining in the current month and adding remaining full months; use addition to solve
Investigate how many days are in each month; discuss why some months have different numbers of days

response_modes.reason: Counting days across a month boundary requires a multi-step reasoning process (days remaining in first month + days in intervening months + days in final month). The reasoning scaffold needs to be made visible and practised before students can apply it independently.

success_criteria: Counts the number of days between two events in the same month
Determines the date 2 weeks after a given date using a calendar
